paras: Cnemaspis mcguirei, also known commonly as McGuire's rock gecko and the Bitang round-eyed gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is native to Peninsular Malaysia and Thailand.
The specific name, mcguirei, is in honor of American herpetologist Jimmy A. McGuire.
Cnemaspis mcguirei may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 6.5 cm (2.6 in). The male has a yellow-centered black eyespot in the shoulder region.
Cnemaspis mcguirei is found in northern Peninsular Malaysia and adjacent extreme southern Thailand.
The preferred natural habitat of Cnemaspis mcguirei is forest, at altitudes of 500–1,351 m (1,640–4,432 ft).
Cnemaspis mcguirei is terrestrial and active both day and night.
Cnemaspis mcguirei is oviparous. Clutch size is two eggs, and the species may breed year round.
